issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Constrain lid hinge edge to stay coincident with base rear edge with only small uniform clearance across all open views, no white background gap.
issues.visible_evidence: Renders 27 and 44 show white background strip between lid bottom and base rear, source 27 and 44 show tight dark hinge contact with no through-gap.

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Constrain lid width to match base width so side edges stay flush in frontal views.
issues.visible_evidence: Render 27 lid overhangs base on both sides with right edge clipped at frame, source 27 lid side edges align with base sides under hand hold.

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Constrain interior display face to stay dark when source shows powered-off black screen, do not project exterior lid graphics onto interior.
issues.visible_evidence: Source 27 screen is blank black, render 27 shows mirrored exterior NITRO graphics on screen face.

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Do not penalize right-border clipping alone as geometry error when source also clips.
issues.visible_evidence: Both source 27 and render 27 touch right border at lid/hand, so overflow is inherited framing not new geometry.

limitations: Seam UVs are approximate full-image hints, not metric truth.
Camera depth/q are estimates; scale judged from visible alignment only.
Display content changes across video; blur from native texture not measured.
Cannot certify hidden contact thickness or simulation.

proposed_rules.rule: Keep lid footprint width equal to base width and lid depth equal to base depth so closed top view is flush on front and sides.
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: Exact millimeter size and thickness not observable.

proposed_rules.rule: Keep lid hinge edge coincident with base rear edge across all open states, allowing only a small non-penetrating clearance without visible through-gap.
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: Internal hinge mechanism and exact clearance unknown.

proposed_rules.rule: Keep correct faces outward: exterior graphics only on lid outer face, dark/display graphics only on inner face as seen in source.
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: Underside and unseen faces not verifiable.

proposed_rules.rule: Prevent lid sinking into base/keyboard in closed and near-closed views; maintain non-penetrating stacked slabs.
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: No penetration observed here, but hidden interpenetration cannot be ruled out.

sample_reviews.evidence: Closed top view lid exterior logo/stripes match source, front edge seam aligns, no sinking visible.
Source screen blank black with hands, render screen shows exterior NITRO graphics and white hinge gap, lid overhangs base and clips right border like source hand does.
Frontal open view both fully visible, display logo roughly matches but render blurry, white hinge gap in render vs tight source hinge.

summary: Closed view is plausible with no oversize or sinking seen. Claimed right-overflow in 27 is inherited source clipping, but render 27 lid is too wide vs base. No sinking found; opposite residual rear gap in 27/44. Display texture mismatched in 27.
